markings/cad.note: True size, one unit = one foot. Each drawing opens as one block insert on layer P-PMARK; block geometry is a SOLID hatch with its outline on layer 0, ByBlock. Base point: the middle of an arrow's tail, or the bottom center of a word or symbol (top center for yield line triangles, which sit on the line). Caltrans blocks follow the 2026 Standard Plans; (R) arrows are mirror images, as the plans direct. Striping details (CT-DET) run along +X for one full repeat, base point at the start of the reference line, in marking colors. Plan-library blocks are at true size. Green bike crossing dashes (PM-BIKE-XING) repeat every 8 ft along the crossing path (ARRAYPATH). Raised elements are plan outlines at true size.
